messages:
Nora (AE): Miramar sent an RFP asking for an RFI + 3-week POC. Primary scope: embeddings-driven search + a small reranking model. They want POC schedule, cost estimate for ~20M gen tokens + 4M embeddings, KMS/HSM posture, and a capability matrix. Can SE/sec/sre sync now?

Diego (SE): Quick sync: propose 3 weeks — week1 data ingest & mapping, week2 latency tuning + Dedicated pool, week3 acceptance and knowledge transfer. Need anonymized sample docs, SSO test user, and a one-paragraph acceptance checklist. I can own the technical runbook.

Nora (AE): I can draft the capability matrix. Pricing: what should I tell them for planning, and can we offer a limited POC cap instead of discount?

Diego (SE): For planning, ballpark hosted gen $0.00058/token, embeddings $0.00082/embed. For a short pilot we can do either: (a) 30% POC discount on committed consumption, or (b) a fixed spend cap with flat support for the POC. Recommend Dedicated if they need consistent 95th/99th tail latency.

Asha (Security): RFI security items to address: CMK/KMS support, on-prem HSM option, retention of admin/access audit logs, SOC2 + pen test evidence, and data residency. Draft wording to paste into RFI answers:
```
Redwood supports customer-managed encryption keys via AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and Azure Key Vault for hosted and Private deployments. For Private/on-prem installations we support HSM integrations; Redwood does not export persistent private key material from a customers HSM. Audit logs for administrative and access events are configurable and can be retained per contract (standard 90-day retention; extended retention available). Redacted SOC2 and pen-test summaries can be provided under NDA.
```

Diego (SE): I'll include that and add a short note about fallback routing to a compatible smaller model if Dedicated capacity is strained. Also adding a note about our model verification tests to the capability matrix.

Becca (SRE): We have a 2-GPU Dedicated test pool available in eu-west-1 for the POC window. Suggest autoscale min=1, max=3. I can reserve the pool and produce a concise runbook (deploy, telemetry endpoints, escalation). Will attach cost-tracking tags to resources so finance can do an after-action estimate.

Nora (AE): Action list: Nora will upload capability_matrix_v1 and the initial RFI bundle; Diego finalizes technical answers, Asha will share SOC2/KMS links and a one-paragraph HSM blurb for legal, Becca reserves pool + writes runbook. Contracts: I'll ask about a short POC addendum and whether Miramar needs a separate DPA.

POC-bot: Created ticket POC-5012 and assigned to Diego (SE). Due date: 1725140000.

Diego (SE): I'll update the ticket with the final RFI bundle. If anyone has concise legal-approved HSM phrasing, paste it here. :mag: 

Asha (Security): Dropping links (access controlled): https://vault.redwood/soc2/redacted and https://vault.redwood/kms-integration. I'll DM contracts to suggest the POC addendum wording.

Nora (AE): Goal: send Miramar full RFI + POC proposal by tomorrow 09:30 PT. Thanks team! :rocket:
